title: Bench harness: a verdict you can trust
problem: A bench run on a busy machine returns numbers that look precise and are not, and nothing says so.
solution: The harness waits for a calm machine, samples it during the run, and compares runs with statistics that say when a difference is real.
furtherNotes: Runs on the quiet machine through bench-remote.

options.label: Load check before the run
userStories: As a developer, I want the bench to refuse a loaded machine, so that I never read noise as a result
implementationDecisions: The lock samples load average before it hands over the machine.
testingDecisions: Drive the lock with a faked load average.

options.label: Wait until calm
userStories: As a developer, I want the bench to wait for a calm machine, so that I do not retry by hand
implementationDecisions: The wait is bounded and reports how long it waited.

options.label: Calm verdict in the report
userStories: As a reviewer, I want the report to state the machine state, so that I can trust the numbers

options.label: In-run sampling
userStories: As a developer, I want load sampled during the run, so that a mid-run spike is caught

options.label: Compare two runs
userStories: As a developer, I want to compare two runs, so that I know whether a change helped
